answer: Earnings go into a per-seat vault that releases on a terrace schedule: each step unlocks only after the seat passes another blind task set by a different random panel. A clawback window spans every terrace, so if two seats later prove to share prompts, timing or wording, both vaults are seized before payout. An attacker running 500 fakes must keep 500 seats producing distinct graded work for weeks, and one detection spiral of linked audits empties the whole farm.
